correctness.rationale: Original-population class monochromaticity and threshold-two clipping reduce all arbitrary positive sizes to exactly 729 cases. The included finite_certificate.py checks F^7=F^4 for all 729, proves the 31-monomial EGF equality from the 122 oscillating signatures, and identifies a sharp four-step example. The direct independent implementation checks 752877 labelled configurations across 45 sizes. Coefficient extraction, existence intervals and fixed-clique limit follow algebraically and by a union bound. Finite vertex experiments alone are not used to infer the universal result.
